properties.name: Redundant stone built support for old aqueduct.
Remains of old stone built arched bridge.

properties.description: Short section of stone and concrete aqueduct. There was no coal on the Isle of Man. Laxey Mining industry relied on water power. Demand outstripped supply so the mines lay dormant in the summer. A wood lade (leat) was built to channel water from Glen Roy…

properties.name: Bellite factory ruins
properties.description: Around 1890, a group of Swedish businessmen decided to build a bellite factory here. However, the business operating license was withdrawn due to safety concerns before the factory was finished, and the shell of it has remained much the same ever since.

properties.name: Mount Strange
properties.description: Ruins of late 17th century summerhouse built by the Derbys and named for James Stanley, 7th Earl of Derby, formerly Lord Strange.

caveats: STRUCTURALLY UNSAFE. A ruin is a ruin: walls and roofs may be collapsing and floors and cellars open. Do not enter.
